decoded_length.description: integer variable holding a decoded length/count from untrusted input

place_value_multiplier.description: integer variable holding a place-value multiplier in base-N decoding

output_capacity.description: integer parameter giving the capacity of the output buffer

output_offset.description: integer variable holding the current write offset in the output buffer

wide_integer.description: 64-bit integer type used to prevent overflow

untrusted_input.description: pointer/array parameter holding untrusted encoded input
